description: Provenance lens: filter pages.json by vb:provenance, vb:review, vb:status and whether a signature is declared (not verified). OR within a dimension, AND across. Only the count is a live region.

attributes.name: data-lens-src
attributes.description: URL to pages.json (or compatible source). Read at setup; forwarded by content-lens.

attributes.name: data-label-form
attributes.description: Accessible name of the controls form.

attributes.name: data-label-signed
attributes.description: Legend of the signature group. pages.json signed means a vb:signature meta is present, not that it verified.

attributes.name: data-label-page
attributes.description: Count template when Intl.PluralRules selects "one" for {total}.

attributes.name: data-label-pages
attributes.description: Count template for every other plural category.

attributes.name: data-label-has-signature
attributes.description: Result-row note for pages that declare a signature.

attributes.name: data-label-error
attributes.description: Message when the source fails (detail goes to console.warn, never rendered).

attributes.name: data-label-no-source
attributes.description: Message when neither data-lens-src nor src is set.

events.name: trust-filter:change
events.description: Fires when the reader ticks, unticks or clears a filter. selected is a per-dimension array of values. Not fired on the initial render or on reconnect.

structure.description: Generated. One fieldset[data-dim] per dimension with nested label > input[type=checkbox][data-dim] (no ids), plus a reset button. Rebuilt unchecked on every setup, and the selection is cleared with it.
Generated polite live region holding only "N of M pages"; filled on first render without an announcement.
Generated results list, a sibling of the count (not a live region); hidden when empty. Links that are not http(s) or relative render as plain text.
Generated provenance chip; coloured per token (~=) with theme tokens.
Rendered when there is no source or the source fails to load.
